WITH money AS (
  SELECT
    ca.Claim_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS losses_paid,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserves
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" AS ca
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment" AS lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" AS lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)

  cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
  cat.Catastrophe_Name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS claim_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(m.losses_paid), 0) AS total_loss_paid,
  COALESCE(SUM(m.loss_reserves), 0) AS total_loss_reserved,
